newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina postpones hydroelectric dam sale.
newsitem.headline: Argentina postpones hydroelectric dam sale.

text.p: The deadline for bids in the privatization of Argentina's Pichi Picun Leufu hydroelectric dam has been delayed until December 20, an official from the company said Thursday.

Jose Papalardo, the official in charge of the sale at Pichi Picun, told Reuters the deadline has been pushed back because the bidders for the dam have asked for an extension. The previous deadline was December 9.
The sale has already been pushed back once from an original deadline at the beginning of November.

Companies that have bought the tender specifications for the 261 MW dam in Neuquen province include Argentine firms Hidroelectrica El Chocon, CAPEX and Perez Companc, in addition to Entergy and AES from the United States. U.S. company Duke Power Co. has also bought the specifications.
Papalardo said the final decision on the winner will be taken on January 7.
